speaker: card
text: Paper Night. The pen is chained to the table.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Marrow reads the car's number, not yours.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The Voice reads the figure and rounds it. Twelve Hundred.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Forty-one keys on the Tag Board now. Rook hung the last one.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Every key is a car the league took back.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The parts shop leaves one bulb on, over the empty bay.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Your first receipt has four lines. You understand three.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The fourth says road levy, in Marrow's own hand.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Keep it. Marrow keeps a different copy.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Scree on the Yards road, and scree on the shop floor.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Under a sheet in the back sits a bare Line frame.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Nobody bid on it, the Mechanic says, so it's nobody's.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Relay asks you to carry a sealed gearbox across the Yards.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: It has no league stamp. Nothing in the basin has no league stamp.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The prize still pays if you refuse. Relay won't ask twice.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Rook's Needle rolls to the grid with a league tag on its mirror.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The Mechanic offers to hide it behind his curtain. Rook looks behind it.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: He says no. He doesn't say what he saw.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Wipe the soot off the Tag Board and the names come up.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Three rows down: Rook's own key. Hung apart from the rest: Tull's.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Clear the qualifier. Rook's gate is next.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Rook has never lost at his own gate.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: He polished the tag on his mirror this morning, so it would look paid.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Win outright. Second is just a better view of him.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Cinder Row stamps a lost hand's name into every ingot.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Rook pulls up beside your pit in a Trail, with no tags to hang.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Ox watches him from the furnace door, and doesn't look away.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The lender's stall is painted the same red as the Crown.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The fee is written where you can read it. That's new.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The Mechanic will fix the car without the loan. He says so twice.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Ox's Bastion owns every straight in Cinder Row.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: She runs wide in the hairpins and never seems to mind.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Her crew counts your brake lights from the furnace door.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: A new house car rolls off Ox's belt, still warm.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Its driver has a fleet number instead of a name.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: His key hangs on the Tag Board in the Yards.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Crew wages and your payments land in the same account.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Ox has a second set of receipts, folded into her vest.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: She keeps them there, and keeps her crew fed.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The Mechanic asks Ox's crew for an offcut, for a thing.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: A young hand says Ox's caution keeps the crew poor.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Clear the qualifier. Ox will race for the account.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Ox reads the Roll Call. Every name.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Two receipts sit in her vest.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Win outright to see the second.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Cinder Row's furnaces are cold. The crew eats at the door anyway.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Vex drives through on a haul and slows down to look.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: On the Salt Cut they race at dusk. Noon would blind you.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Tyre tracks run out at the third cairn and don't come back.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The Cairn Log says Tull crashed there alone, two winters ago.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Vex laps the third cairn faster than anywhere else.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Your ammunition crate comes back from the league depot light.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The Mechanic weighs it at the counter and swaps it before you notice.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Behind him, a quarry drum is now bolted to the bare frame.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The Cairn Log names a house car as the Salt Line record holder.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Vex knows the real time. He has never once said it aloud.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Win untouched today, and the haulers will talk about it.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Vex's stopwatch stopped two winters ago, at the third cairn.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: He winds it every dusk and never lets it run.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: He won't give it up. The crews have stopped asking.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Relay reads the Cairn Log twice, by lamp, at the third cairn.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: One line has been scraped off and written over in league ink.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Clear the qualifier. Vex is waiting on the flats.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: One stopwatch, stopped two winters ago at the third cairn.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Vex carries it in his fist on the grid.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: First place opens the fist.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The shop climbs the pass on a trailer, in silence, as the custom asks.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: At the first hut, Mica asks the Mechanic his name. He has to think.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Vex races up here now for nothing but the record.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Ox's receipts, the Yards tags and Relay's log, on one hut table.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Three regions. One handwriting.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Mica reads them all and says nothing for a long time.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Every hut on the pass has a radio, and every radio has the Voice.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: He still calls you Twelve Hundred. A clerk on the line corrects him.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Then Marrow, on air, for once: let it stand.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Runoff has washed the ink off half the road signs.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Mica gives each crew a different copy of the evidence.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: No single seized car can carry it all away now.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Mica keeps every hut open to anyone, enemy or not.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Asked to shut them to Marrow, she says no.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: That night his Bulwark parks outside her hut, and she lets him in.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Marrow knew the Mechanic at six, sweeping his garage.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Tonight, at Mica's table, he offers the bench back, and a clean page.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The page goes in the apron, unsigned. Mica watches.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Mica's knife is on the dash, next to Marrow's cloth strips.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: She hasn't decided what it's for.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Win outright and she'll decide.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The Crown gates check every car's paper.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Relay's comes back with a clause nine. He has never seen one.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: His car goes to the Lien Wall. He walks in carrying a sealed gearbox.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Half the Crown grid wears fleet numbers instead of names.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Marrow's Bulwark sits on pole. He swept the start line himself.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The Mechanic says a rating can't choose a line. Choose one.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Marrow waits for the Voice to finish, as he always has.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Tonight it takes forty minutes, and every line is about him.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: He interrupts once. The Voice had rounded.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Relay's sealed gearbox, seal still on. Rook's tyres. Ox's plate.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Vex's watch ticks in the drum; Mica's pins hold it down.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The only registered thing on it is the shim, and that's Marrow's pardon.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: A new line on your receipt: registration, under review.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Marrow has stopped talking about money. He talks about the car.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: He chains the Crown's exits for the longest race of the year.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Clause nine is one sentence long and a week old.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: It makes every registered car on the road the league's.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The Mechanic's rig was never registered.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Marrow sweeps the start line himself.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Your car waits on the plinth, chained, his tag on the mirror.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The rig only drops while it's rolling. Don't stop.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: Your key comes home with Marrow's clamp cut through.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: The Mechanic takes the mine rack off the rig first.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: card
text: By the door there's a new hook, at your height.
voice_direction: Not voiced: story-card caption, read at TV distance

speaker: voice
text: The figure's got some change on it. I don't do change. Twelve Hundred.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Ash on the Yards road. Six cars. Twelve Hundred at the bottom of the paper.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: The Yards are listening. They usually are, when someone owes.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Twelve Hundred again. The basin has started to remember the name.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Cinder Row. The belt never stops. It's stopped for this.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Rook on the grid with no tags to hang. The Yards are still talking.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Dusk on the flats. The glare's down. The log is open.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Salt Cut. Mind the third cairn. Everybody does.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Thin Air. They cross the pass in silence. Not tonight.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: The pass is open. The grit is low. Six cars, one road.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: The Crown. Empty stands, full grid. The basin is listening.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Mister Marrow on the grid. First time in a long time.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Same booth. Same voice. Different paper.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Twelve Hundred's paper reads nothing owed. First time I've said that on air.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Twelve Hundred, again. The paper's patient.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Third try. The basin has stopped switching off.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Rook's gate. Nine years unbeaten. A tow truck is parked by the board.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Ox on the line. Twenty years on the belt. The furnace door is full.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Dusk on the Salt Line. Vex holds the real record. The log disagrees.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: The keeper of the pass, racing on her own road. The huts are quiet.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: From the book: the league thanks Rook for nine years at the gate, in advance.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: From the book: tow crews are asked to stand by the Tag Board. That is all.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: From the book: the Tag Board is league property. Do not clean it.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: From the book: the belt resumes at the next shift, whatever the result.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: From the book: interest on Yards accounts is suspended. The league is generous.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: From the book: tonight's times will be entered in the Cairn Log by league staff only.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: From the book: the league thanks the huts of the pass for their continued neutrality.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: From the book: one car has been retired at the gate under clause nine. Racing continues.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: From the book: registrations are under review. Drivers will be informed.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: From the book: a lien has been posted under clause nine. In good order.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: From the book: the car of Twelve Hundred has been retired under clause nine.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Correction to the record. I've never said that before. Settle in.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Forty minutes of corrections. I'll take them in order.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Third cairn, two winters back. I called it a driver alone. I was reading his paper. Correction.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Twelve Hundred, first. Somebody in the Yards just lost a bet.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: First win for Twelve Hundred. The paper doesn't care. The Yards do.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Twelve Hundred, first, at the Crown. The house has noticed.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Twelve Hundred, down the order. The paper gets paid either way.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Twelve Hundred is off the road. The tow crews know the way.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Off again. The Yards' mechanic will have opinions.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: First, and not a scratch. The Yards' mechanic will be impossible.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: From the back of the paper to the front. I'll stop calling it luck.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Mined. The league will send somebody a bill.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: The gate holds. Rook keeps his car another night.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Close isn't first. Nothing changes hands tonight.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Rook's gate is open. The tow truck has a job after all.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Ox, beaten on her own belt. First time in twenty years.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Vex, second on the flats. Somebody check the log.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: The keeper of the pass, beaten on her own road. The huts are very quiet.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Rook, out of a Trail, pitted next to Twelve Hundred. Write your own story.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: The belt has stopped. Cinder Row is eating at the door. I just call it.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Vex is out of the haul book. Racing for the record. Only the record.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: No grit going up the pass this winter. The keeper knows why.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Listen for engines. When there's one, I'll say so.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: No laps tonight. I'll count cars instead. There are two.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Your engine is collateral. Every race buys another day. Marrow keeps the books.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Beat the division boss. Give them a reason to stand beside you.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: A beaten rival. A new ally. Their backing keeps you on the road.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: Marrow has taken your car. The debt was never meant to end.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: No laps. No points. The last car running ends this.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: voice
text: The ledger is closed. This road belongs to the living.
voice_direction: Callum noir: low, dry, unhurried; full stops are the pauses

speaker: marrow
text: A good chassis. I will remember it.
voice_direction: UNCAST (needs casting): low, unhurried older man; even, never louder; full stops as beats

speaker: marrow
text: Four lines. Each one fair. M.
voice_direction: Not voiced: ledger remark under the receipt, signed M.

speaker: marrow
text: Keep this. Compare it with the next one. M.
voice_direction: Not voiced: ledger remark under the receipt, signed M.

speaker: marrow
text: A sound result. The car is depreciating more slowly than most. M.
voice_direction: Not voiced: ledger remark under the receipt, signed M.

speaker: marrow
text: The levy keeps the road open. You are welcome to walk instead. M.
voice_direction: Not voiced: ledger remark under the receipt, signed M.

speaker: marrow
text: Time is a cost. I only pass it on. M.
voice_direction: Not voiced: ledger remark under the receipt, signed M.

speaker: marrow
text: A good result for the car. M.
voice_direction: Not voiced: ledger remark under the receipt, signed M.

speaker: marrow
text: A poor result, correctly recorded. M.
voice_direction: Not voiced: ledger remark under the receipt, signed M.

speaker: marrow
text: Repairs insured. The car will be good as new. You will be as you were. M.
voice_direction: Not voiced: ledger remark under the receipt, signed M.

speaker: marrow
text: Recovered amounts returned per the book. The book was always willing. M.
voice_direction: Not voiced: ledger remark under the receipt, signed M.

speaker: marrow
text: Nearly settled. Nearly is a long word. M.
